questions.prompt: Write the vector with components \(3\), \(-2\), and \(5\) as a column vector in \(\mathbb R^3\).
questions.answer:
We are writing the listed components in order as a vector in \(\mathbb R^3\). A column vector places each component in its own row:
\[
\mathbf v=\begin{pmatrix}3\\-2\\5\end{pmatrix}.
\]
The vector has three real components, so \(\mathbf v\in\mathbb R^3\).

questions.prompt: For \(\mathbf u=(4,-1,7)\in\mathbb R^3\), identify the second component and state the dimension of the ambient space.
questions.answer:
The vector is ordered as \((u_1,u_2,u_3)=(4,-1,7)\). Therefore the second component is
\[
u_2=-1.
\]
There are three components, so the ambient space is \(\mathbb R^3\), which has dimension \(3\).

questions.prompt: Let \(\mathbf a=(2,0,-3,1)\). Decide whether \(\mathbf a\) belongs to \(\mathbb R^3\), \(\mathbb R^4\), or both.
questions.answer:
We count the number of components. The vector \(\mathbf a=(2,0,-3,1)\) has four real components. Therefore
\[
\mathbf a\in\mathbb R^4.
\]
It is not an element of \(\mathbb R^3\), because vectors in \(\mathbb R^3\) have exactly three components. So \(\mathbf a\) belongs to \(\mathbb R^4\) only.

questions.prompt: Find all real \(t\) such that \((t,2t-1,5)=(3,s,5)\) for some real \(s\), and then find \(s\).
questions.answer:
Two vectors in \(\mathbb R^3\) are equal exactly when corresponding components are equal. Compare the first components:
\[
t=3.
\]
Now compare the second components using \(t=3\):
\[
s=2t-1=2(3)-1=5.
\]
The third components are both \(5\), so they already match. Therefore \(t=3\) and \(s=5\).
